Method of Attack: Extracts cookies from browsers and stores them locally
Self-propagates by uploading malicious videos to YouTube using stolen cookies
Attack Vector: Malicious YouTube videos containing links to fake cracks and cheats
Stolen cookies used to log into victims' YouTube accounts to upload malware-promoting videos
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Nirsoft NirCmd utility named 'nir.exe'
Discord messages with links to uploaded malicious videos
GitHub repository links used to fetch video URLs
